internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across 36 occurrences qTE is the operation of cutting: making a break in what was continuous or joined. It appears as a literal severing of bodies and objects (aorta 69:46, thieves' hands 5:38, felled palm-trees 59:5, torn intestines 47:15), as the eradication idiom of cutting off the 'dabir' trailing remnant (6:45, 7:72, 8:7), as severing relational bonds (explicitly the antonym of 'to be joined' at 2:27 and 13:25, kinship at 47:22, the 'asbab' means at 2:166/22:15, communal unity into sects at 21:93/23:53, hearts at 9:110), as nominal 'portions/pieces' of a continuum (a stretch of night 11:81/15:65, patches of dark night 10:27, adjacent land-plots 13:4) and division into organized units (twelve tribes 7:160, nations 7:168), and as the termination/closure of an ongoing state (unending fruit 'not cut off' 56:33, concluding a matter 27:32). One occurrence resists: 9:121 'traverse a valley' means crossing undivided terrain, not severance.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: qTE does NOT entail: (1) annihilation - severed things persist as distinct pieces (10:27 patches, 13:4 plots, 7:160 twelve tribes); eradication enters only via the dabir idiom where what is cut off is the continuation itself. (2) joining - it is the explicit lexical opposite of wasala (2:27, 13:25). (3) a fixed instrument, manner, or blade - applies to time (11:81), kinship (47:22), bonds (2:166), routes (29:29), deliberation (27:32). (4) a fixed valence - lawful punishment (5:38), neutral divine structuring (7:160), villainy (12:31), torment (47:15). (5) a fixed agent/voice - active (5:38), passive (6:45), mediopassive (2:166, 6:94, 9:110). (6) complete detachment - 13:4 qita' are mutajawirat (contiguous/adjacent). (7) 'into many pieces' at root level - that is Form II/V, not Form I. (8) withholding - distinguished from man' at 56:33 (maqtu'a vs mamnu'a).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 9:121:8:1 وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًا means to traverse/cover a valley (movement through undivided terrain), a sense no other packet occurrence licenses; it resists the severance/discontinuity nucleus on strict Quran-internal evidence. The context (recording of expenditure and ground covered in God's cause) forces 'cross/cover distance', which leaves the valley whole and continuous - the opposite of separation, division, or cessation. Its own root-mate 29:29 تَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ (obstruct/sever safe passage) points the opposite pragmatic direction on a near-identical path-object, so the internal path-pair itself refuses to disambiguate toward unity; folding 9:121 in requires a motion-as-line metaphor supplied from outside the corpus, barred under QURAN-INTERNAL ONLY.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge on a single severance/discontinuity nucleus organized as a transparent, morphologically predictable derivational family (I/II/V/N), broad across 36 occurrences and four forms, and adversarially anchored by the explicit antonymy with wasala 'to join' (2:27, 13:25). Per the contract's anti-over-grading discipline it is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL because: (i) a materially RESISTANT occurrence, 9:121 'traverse a valley', is not Quran-internally bridgeable to the nucleus; (ii) the unifying nucleus must be stated broadly enough to embrace antonymic outcomes on the same collocation أمر (close/settle a decision at 27:32 vs fragment into sects at 21:93/23:53), a distinctiveness strain; and (iii) a coherent nominal sub-class (qit'/qita' of night and land) plus the contiguous-parcels boundary at 13:4 exist. candidate_root_contribution: qTE introduces a discontinuity into something continuous, whole, or connected: it severs a part from a whole, breaches a connection, or terminates an ongoing continuity. The continuum is domain-neutral (material, spatial, temporal, relational); the derivation modulates telicity/plurality/voice (I = single telic severance, II = intensive/distributive severance or division into many parts, V = mediopassive coming-apart, N = the piece produced / the severed state / the one who brings to a decisive close).

layer_attribution.derivation: Form I = single telic severance/breach; Form II = intensive/pluractional/distributive severance or division into many parts; Form V = mediopassive coming-apart/self-fragmentation; Form N = product-noun (qit'/qita' 'piece'), state-participle (maqtu' 'cut off'), and agent (qati'a 'one who brings to a decisive close').
